ready_paraphrase: Mohanty remembered arriving at his NSD audition unsure of his Hindi and English. He was allowed to perform in Odia. Years later, preparing to play a fisherman in Chilika Tire, he recalled spending time living with fishermen. The two memories offer a useful connection: the language he brought with him and the attention he gave to lives beyond his own.
